description: MFS Payment Gateway v2 - Tokenization, retry handling, multi-currency, and settlement processing services.

files.description: Payment tokenization service with PCI DSS v4.0 compliant token generation and HSM integration.
Idempotent payment retry handler with exponential backoff and circuit breaker pattern.
Circuit breaker implementation with closed/open/half-open state machine.
Multi-currency exchange rate service with real-time FX rate lookup and caching.
AES-256-GCM encryption/decryption service for cardholder data at rest.
Settlement batch processor with transaction aggregation and ISO 8583 file generation.
Real-time balance reconciliation engine comparing gateway ledger vs settlement records.
REST API routes for payment processing, tokenization, and currency conversion endpoints.
REST API routes for settlement batch management and reconciliation reporting.
SQLAlchemy models for payment transactions, tokens, and settlement records in mfs_payments_db.
Database connection configuration for mfs_payments_db and mfs_audit_db on pghost-prod-01.mfs.internal.
HSM PKCS#11 configuration for svc-token-vault service account key operations.
Webhook dispatcher service. Delivers payment event notifications to merchant-registered callback URLs with HMAC signature verification.
Webhook delivery retry handler with exponential backoff strategy for failed webhook deliveries.
Dead letter queue management for permanently failed webhook deliveries after retry exhaustion.
Transaction analytics aggregator. Computes aggregated transaction metrics, settlement summaries, and merchant performance data.

symbols.name: TokenizationService
symbols.docstring: PCI DSS v4.0 compliant payment tokenization service. Generates irreversible tokens for cardholder PANs using HSM-managed keys via svc-token-vault.

symbols.name: create_token
symbols.docstring: Create a payment token from cardholder PAN. Stores encrypted data in mfs_payments_db.card_tokens.

symbols.name: validate_pan
symbols.docstring: Validate PAN using Luhn algorithm and card brand detection.

symbols.name: RetryHandler
symbols.docstring: Idempotent payment retry handler with exponential backoff. Uses SHA-256(transaction_id + merchant_id) as idempotency key.

symbols.name: execute_with_retry
symbols.docstring: Execute payment operation with retry logic. Max 3 retries with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s).

symbols.name: CircuitBreaker
symbols.docstring: Circuit breaker with CLOSED/OPEN/HALF_OPEN states. Opens after 5 consecutive failures, probes every 30s.

symbols.name: call
symbols.docstring: Execute operation through circuit breaker. Raises CircuitBreakerOpenError if breaker is open.

symbols.name: CurrencyExchangeService
symbols.docstring: Real-time currency exchange rate service. Fetches FX rates from provider API with 60s TTL cache. Supports USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF.

symbols.name: convert
symbols.docstring: Convert amount between currencies at current FX rate with 0.01% accuracy guarantee. Logs conversion to mfs_audit_db.

symbols.name: EncryptionService
symbols.docstring: AES-256-GCM encryption service for cardholder data at rest. Uses HSM-managed keys via svc-token-vault on mfs-vault-pod-01.

symbols.name: encrypt
symbols.docstring: Encrypt cardholder data field using AES-256-GCM with HSM key. Returns ciphertext with IV and auth tag.

symbols.name: SettlementBatchProcessor
symbols.docstring: Settlement batch processor. Aggregates transactions by merchant/currency/acquirer and generates ISO 8583 settlement files.

symbols.name: BatchAggregator
symbols.docstring: Groups completed transactions from gateway_ledger by merchant_id, currency, and acquiring_bank.

symbols.name: ReconciliationEngine
symbols.docstring: Real-time balance reconciliation engine. Compares gateway_ledger entries against settlement_records and flags discrepancies > $0.01.

symbols.name: ReconciliationReportGenerator
symbols.docstring: Generates daily and on-demand reconciliation reports. Writes results to mfs_audit_db.

symbols.name: create_token
symbols.docstring: POST /api/v2/tokens - Create payment token from cardholder PAN.

symbols.name: process_payment
symbols.docstring: POST /api/v2/payments - Process payment using token with idempotency key.

symbols.name: CardToken
symbols.docstring: SQLAlchemy model for card_tokens table in mfs_payments_db.

symbols.name: get_payments_db_engine
symbols.docstring: Create SQLAlchemy engine for mfs_payments_db on pghost-prod-01.mfs.internal using svc-payment-api credentials.

symbols.name: get_audit_db_engine
symbols.docstring: Create SQLAlchemy engine for mfs_audit_db on pghost-prod-01.mfs.internal.

symbols.name: WebhookDispatcher
symbols.docstring: Webhook dispatcher service. Delivers payment event notifications to merchant-registered callback URLs with HMAC payload signing.

symbols.name: dispatch
symbols.docstring: Dispatch a payment event notification to all registered webhook URLs for the merchant.

symbols.name: sign_payload
symbols.docstring: Sign webhook payload with HMAC-SHA256 using the merchant's webhook signing secret from vault.

symbols.name: RetryHandler
symbols.docstring: Webhook delivery retry handler with exponential backoff. Retries failed deliveries up to 5 times with increasing delays.

symbols.name: retry_with_backoff
symbols.docstring: Retry a failed webhook delivery with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s). Moves to DLQ after exhaustion.

symbols.name: DeadLetterQueue
symbols.docstring: Dead letter queue for webhook deliveries that have exhausted all retry attempts.

symbols.name: enqueue
symbols.docstring: Enqueue a permanently failed webhook delivery into the dead letter queue with full payload and error context.

symbols.name: replay
symbols.docstring: Replay a dead-lettered webhook delivery, resetting retry count and re-dispatching to the merchant endpoint.

symbols.name: AnalyticsAggregator
symbols.docstring: Transaction analytics aggregator. Computes aggregated metrics from gateway_ledger and settlement_records for reporting dashboards.

symbols.name: aggregate
symbols.docstring: Aggregate transaction metrics over a configurable time window. Returns volume, success rates, and settlement summaries.
